description: This file implements RFC parameter management, including reading/writing parameters via files and HTTP requests, with support for JSON parsing and curl-based communication. It includes functions for initialization, parameter retrieval, setting, error handling, and feature toggling, specific to RFC configurations in a device management context.

methods.name: getRFCParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an RFC parameter, possibly via HTTP request if the server is ready.

methods.name: setRFCParameter
methods.description: Sets the value of an RFC parameter via HTTP POST request.

methods.name: getRFCErrorString
methods.description: Returns a string description for a given WDMP_STATUS error code.

methods.name: isRFCEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific RFC feature is enabled by the presence of its ini file.
